Add MASS, boot to DESCRIPTION for parallel

`library(boot)` is used in several package examples, tests, and the vignette; `MASS::` is used in several package examples and the e.g.

https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/blob/d24a7e7156e9b6411190046dcd231c31b5ba3578/src/library/parallel/vignettes/parallel.Rnw#L596

AIUI this makes MASS and boot Suggests dependencies for parallel. Certainly it's hard to see why they would be excluded when MASS is listed as Suggests for stats:

https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/blob/d24a7e7156e9b6411190046dcd231c31b5ba3578/src/library/stats/DESCRIPTION.in#L11
